Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: demo slots + security Qs

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call: HealthSync is focused on predictable inference latency for user-facing features, strict data isolation for PHI, and minimizing per-token cost for high-throughput batch jobs. You mentioned SOC 2 evidence and audit logs will be prerequisites for procurement.

Next steps (proposing slots so we can lock a technical deep-dive/demo):
- Option A: Fri, 01 Oct — 10:00–11:00 PT (60 min)
- Option B: Sat, 02 Oct — 14:00–15:00 PT (60 min)

Proposed format: 45 min technical walkthrough (runtime, VPC/private deployment options, quantization tradeoffs) + 15 min security/Q&A. Please confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (names + roles).

We can host on Zoom (we’ll send a link) or Google Meet if you prefer — which do you want?

Attached: short mutual action plan (MAP_v1.pdf) and my call notes (discovery_notes_20260927.txt).

If you’d like an SE who owns VPC/on-prem to join, I’ll include Karthik (cc’d). Grace from Customer Success will also join to discuss rollout cadence.

Thanks — look forward to locking a time.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf), discovery_notes_20260927.txt (text/plain)
